seo_title: Adobe Photoshop Course | 6 Weeks, ₹6,900 | Nova Skills
seo_description: Learn Photoshop retouching, compositing, Generative Fill and advertising design. Build a commercial PSD portfolio in 6 weeks, 48 hours, for ₹6,900.
overview: Adobe Photoshop is the global industry benchmark for raster image editing, digital retouching and advertising creative production. This intensive 6-week, 48-hour certification programme provides hands-on, studio-level mastery across precision selections, Camera Raw color grading, portrait and product retouching, photorealistic compositing, Adobe Firefly AI workflows, and multi-format advertising campaigns. Students learn non-destructive layer disciplines and deliver four client-ready portfolio assets backed by meticulously structured, editable PSD source files.
why_now: In an e-commerce, social media and AI-driven commercial landscape, generic image generation is not enough. Brands, agencies and businesses demand authentic visual realism, precise product accuracy, customizable brand assets and organized layered source files that can be revised and deployed across omnichannel formats. This course prepares learners for real-world studio production demands.

modules.title: Design & Photoshop Foundations

topics: Photoshop interface and workspace customization: Tools panel, Options bar, Panels docking, and custom studio workspaces
Document creation, canvas dimensions, pixel aspect ratios, and resolution standards for web, screen, and print
Raster versus vector graphics: mathematical vectors vs pixel matrices, scalability boundaries, and interpolation artifacts
Common raster formats: PSD master working files, JPEG compression algorithms, PNG transparency, and WebP efficiency
Image resolution versus physical print dimensions: Pixels Per Inch (PPI) fundamentals and viewing distance calculation
Color modes: RGB additive color vs CMYK subtractive color, bit depth (8-bit vs 16-bit), and gamut limitations
Color profiles: sRGB for web outputs, Adobe RGB (1998) for wide-gamut workflows, and CMYK prepress target profiles
Core commercial design principles: visual hierarchy, contrast, balance, alignment, proximity, repetition, and purposeful whitespace
Advertising typography fundamentals: font pairing, tracking, leading, kerning, type hierarchy, and legibility over complex backgrounds
Layer fundamentals: background layer unlocking, layer stacking order, opacity vs fill, layer locking modes, and color coding
Transformation and alignment: Free Transform controls, proportional scaling, reference points, Skew, Distort, and Perspective
Rulers, guides, grids, and Smart Guides: precision coordinate positioning and mathematical margin setup
Artboards in Photoshop: multi-canvas setup for social media formats and responsive banner suites
Cropping and composition: Rule of Thirds, Golden Ratio, Straighten tool, and non-destructive crop modes
Studio asset sourcing, moodboard development, file naming conventions, and interpreting commercial design briefs
modules.hands_on_practice: Configure custom commercial workspaces; construct grid-aligned advertising canvases with designated margins and safe zones; balance typographic headlines over product photography with purposeful contrast.

modules.title: Precision Editing
modules.objective: Develop precise, controlled image-editing skills using selections, masks, paths, adjustment layers and Smart Objects.
topics: Selection fundamentals: Geometric Marquee tools, Lasso, Polygonal Lasso, and Magnetic Lasso mechanics
AI-assisted selection tools: Quick Selection, Object Selection Tool, Selection Brush, Magic Wand, and Select Subject engine
Select and Mask dedicated workspace: Global Refinements (Smooth, Feather, Contrast, Shift Edge) and View Modes
Refine Edge Brush: soft-edge isolation, fur and flyaway hair extraction, and edge contamination decontaminate colors
Non-destructive masking: Layer Masks vs permanent pixel deletion, revealing (white), concealing (black), and gray opacity gradients
Clipping masks: bounding adjustment layers and textures strictly to underlying shapes and text layers
Vector masks and Pen Tool mastery: Bézier curves, anchor points, smooth vs corner points, and Path Operations (Add, Subtract, Intersect)
Precision product clipping paths: creating ultra-sharp commercial vector silhouetting for e-commerce catalog isolation
Non-destructive Adjustment Layers: Levels histograms, input/output sliders, black/white/gray eyedroppers, and tonal clipping
Curves deep dive: S-curves for contrast, individual RGB channel curve color grading, and precise point sampling
Color adjustments: Hue/Saturation colorized modes, Color Balance shadow/midtone/highlight grading, Selective Color, and Vibrance
Adobe Camera Raw as a filter: white balance temperature/tint, exposure, highlight recovery, shadow boosting, clarity, and dehaze
Smart Objects architecture: Embedded vs Linked Smart Objects, preserving raw pixel data against destructive degradation
Smart Filters: applying reversible blurs, sharpening, and distortions with independent filter masks
Photoshop Blend Modes: Multiply (darken), Screen (lighten), Overlay/Soft Light (contrast), and Color/Luminosity separation
Layer Effects (Layer Styles): Drop Shadow, Inner Shadow, Stroke, Color Overlay, and Bevel & Emboss with non-destructive control
Quality assurance at 100% and 200% zoom: checking for fringing, halos, jagged edges, and mask bleed
modules.hands_on_practice: Hand-draw vector clipping paths around intricate product contours; isolate models with complex flyaway hair; perform non-destructive color balancing and tone curve corrections without modifying background pixels.

modules.title: Retouching & Image Enhancement
modules.objective: Learn to enhance portraits and products while preserving realistic texture, lighting, geometry and visual authenticity.
topics: Professional retouching philosophy: enhancement vs alteration, visual authenticity, and client brief adherence
Before-and-after image evaluation: identifying sensor dust, scratches, stray hairs, blemishes, and tonal inconsistencies
Healing toolset: Spot Healing Brush (Content-Aware, Proximity Match), Healing Brush (sampled texture), and Patch Tool
The Remove Tool (AI-powered generative cleanup): clearing complex background distractions while reconstructing underlying textures
Clone Stamp Tool: sample alignment, brush hardness, opacity/flow settings, and avoiding repeating stamp patterns
Frequency separation fundamentals: separating high-frequency texture from low-frequency color and tone, and understanding over-smoothing risks
Dodge and Burn techniques: non-destructive 50% gray overlay layers, Curves-based dodging and burning, and sculpting facial/product volume

faq.question: What is Adobe Photoshop — Commercial Image Editing & Design?
faq.answer: Adobe Photoshop — Commercial Image Editing & Design is an intensive 6-week, 48-hour certification programme focused on practical, commercial-grade raster editing, high-end product/portrait retouching, photorealistic compositing, advertising art direction, and multi-format campaign production. Learners master precision tools, non-destructive editing, Adobe Camera Raw, and Adobe Firefly AI features while building a portfolio of client-ready artwork backed by organized, editable PSD files.

faq.question: Is this course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. The course begins with foundational concepts in Photoshop's workspace, pixels, resolution, color modes (RGB vs CMYK), and basic design principles before advancing systematically through precision masking, retouching, compositing, and advertising production. No prior Photoshop experience is required, though general computer literacy and familiarity with digital images are helpful.

faq.question: What is the duration and fee?
faq.answer: The course duration is exactly 6 Weeks (48 total learning hours), priced at a transparent institutional fee of ₹6,900. Nova Skills follows a strict Truth in Pricing policy with zero artificial countdown discounts or inflated comparison prices.

faq.question: Will I learn photo editing and retouching?
faq.answer: Yes, extensive practical photo editing and retouching are core pillars of the curriculum. You will learn to use the Remove Tool, Healing Brush, Spot Healing Brush, Clone Stamp, frequency separation concepts, and Dodge & Burn techniques to clean blemishes, remove distractions, and sculpt light while preserving authentic skin and surface micro-textures.

faq.question: Does the course cover product photo editing?
faq.answer: Yes. Product photo editing is heavily emphasized, covering dust and scratch removal, packaging cleanup, metallic and glass reflection management, label preservation, and hand-rendering realistic contact and cast shadows for e-commerce and commercial print catalogs.

faq.question: Will I learn advanced selections and masking?
faq.answer: Yes. You will master geometric marquees, Lasso tools, Object Selection, Select Subject, and the dedicated Select and Mask workspace. You will also learn sub-pixel hair extraction, Refine Edge techniques, Layer Masks, clipping masks, and the Pen Tool for precision vector clipping paths.

faq.question: What is non-destructive editing?
faq.answer: Non-destructive editing is a professional workflow where original image pixels are never permanently deleted or degraded. By utilizing Layer Masks, non-destructive Adjustment Layers (Curves, Levels, Color Balance), Smart Objects, and Smart Filters, any edit can be modified, re-adjusted, or reverted at any point in the future.

faq.question: Will I learn Adobe Camera Raw?
faq.answer: Yes. Adobe Camera Raw is integrated as an essential supporting tool. You will learn raw exposure balancing, white balance temperature/tint adjustments, highlight recovery, shadow opening, clarity, dehaze, chromatic aberration removal, and selective color grading.

faq.question: Does the course include Generative Fill?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn how to direct Adobe Firefly Generative Fill inside Photoshop to add contextual background elements, replace objects, extend scene environments, and accelerate commercial compositing, while learning how to identify and manually fix AI-generated visual artifacts.

faq.question: Will I learn Harmonize and Generative Expand?
faq.answer: Yes. The course covers Generative Expand for extending canvases seamlessly into new aspect ratios, and the Harmonize tool for matching foreground lighting, color temperature, and shadows to background environment plates, along with supported layer workflows and manual finishing techniques.

faq.question: Does the course require paid Adobe software?
faq.answer: Learners need access to Adobe Photoshop desktop (version 2024 or later recommended) via an active Adobe Creative Cloud subscription or trial. Nova Skills provides laboratory access during studio hours for classroom students. The curriculum teaches desktop Photoshop to ensure access to full professional production tools.

faq.question: Are AI generative credits included?
faq.answer: Adobe Creative Cloud plans include monthly generative credit allocations for Firefly features. The course is carefully structured to teach efficient, prompt-optimized workflows that do not require excessive credit usage, and manual Photoshop alternatives are taught for every AI-assisted step.

faq.question: Will I learn photorealistic compositing?
faq.answer: Yes. Commercial compositing is taught as a major discipline in Module 04. You will learn to evaluate and match camera focal length, perspective angles, horizon lines, lighting direction, color temperature, atmospheric falloff, and shadow physics to blend multiple photos into seamless, believable scenes.

faq.question: Does the course teach advertising design?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 05 focuses on commercial advertising creative production, teaching visual hooks, product hero positioning, message hierarchy, typography styling (headlines, body copy, CTA buttons), brand consistency, and high-converting e-commerce layouts.

faq.question: Will I learn 4:5, 1:1 and 9:16 campaign designs?
faq.answer: Yes. You will complete a dedicated multi-format campaign adaptation project creating 4:5 Portrait Feed (1080×1350 px), 1:1 Square Feed (1080×1080 px), and 9:16 Vertical Story/Reel (1080×1920 px) designs, mastering responsive composition without awkward stretching or cropping.

faq.question: Does the course include print-ready artwork?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn prepress fundamentals including physical dimensions (mm/inches), effective PPI, CMYK color spaces, rich black vs pure black, ICC profile soft proofing, 3mm bleed, trim margins, and export to print-ready PDF/X formats.

faq.question: Will I receive editable PSD source files?
faq.answer: Yes, and more importantly, you will be trained to produce them. The course establishes strict PSD handover standards requiring 10 logical layer groups, non-destructive Smart Objects, and organized client delivery packages. A flattened JPEG alone does not qualify for course completion.

faq.question: What portfolio projects will I create?
faq.answer: You will build four major commercial portfolio projects: (1) Commercial Product Retouching Series across 3 varied products, (2) Photorealistic Commercial Composite, (3) Commercial Product Hero Advertisement, and (4) Three-Format Commercial Campaign Suite (4:5, 1:1, 9:16) with a complete client handover package.

faq.question: Does the course teach vector logo design?
faq.answer: No. Vector logo design and brand identity marks are the domain of vector illustration software (taught in our dedicated Adobe Illustrator course). Course 48 focuses strictly on raster image editing, photo retouching, compositing, and advertising creative production.

faq.question: Does it include advanced video editing or UI/UX?
faq.answer: No. Video editing and motion graphics are specialized in our Premiere Pro and After Effects courses, while digital product interface design is covered in our Figma UI/UX course. Course 48 strictly maintains focus on high-end commercial static imagery and advertising artwork.

faq.question: Is this an official Adobe certification?
faq.answer: This programme awards the Nova Skills Certified Commercial Photoshop Specialist (NS-CPS) credential, an independent institutional qualification certifying commercial production skills and verified portfolio execution. It is not an Adobe Certified Professional (ACP) exam voucher, though the curriculum thoroughly prepares students who wish to sit for ACP exams.

faq.question: What career opportunities are available?
faq.answer: Graduates are qualified for entry-level and junior commercial roles including Junior Photoshop Designer, Photo Retouching Assistant, Product Image Editor, E-commerce Image Editing Executive, Social Media Creative Designer, Advertising Creative Assistant, Digital Imaging Assistant, and Freelance Commercial Image Editor.
